page: Google Cloud Platform a2-highgpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized server configured with eight NVIDIA Ampere A100 GPUs providing a total of 320 GB of VRAM. The system is powered by an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor with 96 vCPUs and 48 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a base clock speed of 2.2 GHz. It includes 680.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.08 GB per core. Local storage is not bundled with this instance type.

Benchmark results indicate a clear division between single-core and multi-core or parallelized workloads. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by lower scores in stress-ng single-core and single-threaded compression tests. However, multi-core CPU performance is strong, and memory bandwidth is highly rated, reaching 4215.1 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 219.95 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. The server excels in GPU-driven tasks, demonstrating top-tier performance in large language model inference prompt processing and text generation across small, medium, and large models.

Given the high density of dedicated hardware accelerators and substantial system memory, this server represents a specialized tier of resource allocation. The qualitative cost profile reflects its positioning as a high-end platform for heavy parallel computing rather than general-purpose hosting. It is optimized for workloads such as large-scale machine learning training, LLM inference, ray tracing, and high-performance computing tasks that can fully leverage the eight dedicated A100 GPUs.
description: Google Cloud Platform a2-highgpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized server designed for highly parallelized computing workloads. It features eight NVIDIA Ampere A100 GPUs with a total of 320 GB of VRAM, paired with an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor offering 96 vCPUs and 680.0 GB of system memory. While single-core CPU benchmarks are weak, the instance delivers strong multi-core performance and exceptional memory bandwidth, with cached read speeds reaching 4215.1 GB/sec. It achieves top-tier results in LLM inference prompt processing and text generation for medium and large models. Local storage is not included. This server is engineered for demanding workloads such as deep learning, large language model inference, ray tracing, and complex scientific simulations that require massive GPU acceleration and high-density parallel processing.
